properties.description: Clones a Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge template into a profile through bulk.MoCloner. Template Organization identifies the source owner; Destination Organization identifies the new profile owner and defaults to Template Organization when empty. Both names resolve exactly before mutation. Template lookup is source-scoped; duplicate-name and final identity checks are destination-scoped. Intersight must permit use of a template and its referenced policies and pools across organizations; submission errors are returned. Select an authorized intersight.endpoint target. Platform and exact source-template identity checks are retained. Wait for Completion monitors derivation for up to 600 seconds, not profile deployment or activation. No automatic rollback or resume is provided; inspect the destination profile before retrying after partial acceptance.

import json
import re
import sys

profileType = sys.argv[9]
organizationName = sys.argv[10]
destinationOrganizationName = sys.argv[18] or organizationName
templateName = sys.argv[11]
newProfileName = sys.argv[12]
description = sys.argv[5]
workflowNameSuffix = sys.argv[6]
waitText = sys.argv[16].strip().lower()
timeoutText = sys.argv[17].strip()

routes = {
    "Server": ("/api/v1/server/ProfileTemplates", "/api/v1/server/Profiles", "server.ProfileTemplate", "server.Profile", ""),
    "Chassis": ("/api/v1/chassis/ProfileTemplates", "/api/v1/chassis/Profiles", "chassis.ProfileTemplate", "chassis.Profile", ""),
    "Domain": ("/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfileTemplates", "/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfileTemplate", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile", "UCS Domain"),
    "Unified Edge": ("/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfileTemplates", "/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfileTemplate", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile", "Unified Edge"),
}
orgPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")
namePattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$")
suffixPattern = re.compile(r"^$|^[A-Za-z0-9][ A-Za-z0-9_.,/:-]{0,63}$")
errors = []
if profileType not in routes:
    errors.append("Profile Type must be exactly Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge.")
if not orgPattern.fullmatch(organizationName):
    errors.append("Template Organization must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
if not orgPattern.fullmatch(destinationOrganizationName):
    errors.append("Destination Organization must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
if not namePattern.fullmatch(templateName):
    errors.append("Template Name must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens.")
if not namePattern.fullmatch(newProfileName):
    errors.append("New Profile Name must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens.")
if description and (len(description) > 1024 or not description[0].isalnum() or any(ord(ch) > 255 for ch in description)):
    errors.append("Description must be empty or at most 1024 Latin-1 characters beginning with a letter or digit.")
if not suffixPattern.fullmatch(workflowNameSuffix):
    errors.append("Workflow Name Suffix must be empty or 1-64 supported characters beginning with a letter or digit.")
if waitText in ("true", "1"):
    waitRequested = "true"
elif waitText in ("false", "0"):
    waitRequested = "false"
else:
    waitRequested = "invalid"
    errors.append("Wait for Completion must be a boolean value.")
try:
    waitTimeoutSeconds = int(timeoutText)
except Exception:
    waitTimeoutSeconds = -1
    errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must be an integer.")
if waitRequested == "true" and not (1 <= waitTimeoutSeconds <= 600):
    errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds is required when waiting and must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
if waitRequested == "false" and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
    errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must not be negative.")

escapedOrganizationName = sys.argv[13]
escapedTemplateName = sys.argv[14]
escapedNewProfileName = sys.argv[15]
templateCollection = ""
profileCollection = ""
expectedTemplateObjectType = ""
expectedProfileObjectType = ""
expectedTargetPlatform = ""
platformFilter = ""
if profileType in routes:
    templateCollection, profileCollection, expectedTemplateObjectType, expectedProfileObjectType, expectedTargetPlatform = routes[profileType]
    if expectedTargetPlatform:
        platformFilter = " and TargetPlatform eq '%s'" % expectedTargetPlatform.replace("'", "''")
organizationLookupFilter = "Name eq '%s'" % escapedOrganizationName
if destinationOrganizationName != organizationName:
    organizationLookupFilter = "(" + organizationLookupFilter + " or Name eq '%s')" % destinationOrganizationName
preparationStatus = "invalid" if errors else "ready"
preparationMessage = " ".join(errors) if errors else "Input, route, OData, schema, and wait-bound validation passed."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"validated": not errors, "errors": errors, "profileType": profileType, "templateOrganization": organizationName, "destinationOrganization": destinationOrganizationName, "waitRequested": waitRequested == "true", "waitTimeoutSeconds": waitTimeoutSeconds if waitRequested == "true" else None}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = preparationStatus in ("invalid", "ready") and bool(preparationMessage and preparationResultJson)

import re
import sys
_inspectionSucceeded = True
templateStatus = ''
templateMessage = ''
templateResultJson = ''
templateMoid = ''
templateTargetPlatform = ''
serverFamily = ''
cloneRequestJson = ''
helperReady = False
def _inspect():
    import json
    import sys

    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    profileType = sys.argv[2]
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    destinationOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[14]
    if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", destinationOrganizationMoid) is None:
        raise ValueError("Validated destination Organization Moid is missing or malformed")
    newProfileName = sys.argv[4]
    description = sys.argv[5]
    workflowNameSuffix = sys.argv[6]
    expectedTemplateObjectType = sys.argv[7]
    expectedProfileObjectType = sys.argv[8]
    routeTargetPlatform = sys.argv[9]
    values = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError("Template response is missing a Results array")
    templateMoid = ""
    templateTargetPlatform = ""
    serverFamily = ""
    cloneRequestJson = ""
    if len(values) == 0:
        templateStatus = "not-found"
        templateMessage = "No exact source template matched Template Name in Template Organization. Check the template owner and endpoint permissions."
    elif len(values) > 1:
        templateStatus = "ambiguous"
        templateMessage = "Multiple source templates matched the exact lookup."
    else:
        item = values[0]
        problems = []
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            problems.append("Template result is not an object.")
        else:
            if not item.get("Moid"):
                problems.append("Template Moid is missing.")
            if item.get("ObjectType") != expectedTemplateObjectType or item.get("ClassId") not in (None, expectedTemplateObjectType):
                problems.append("Template discriminators do not match the selected Profile Type.")
            organization = item.get("Organization")
            if not isinstance(organization, dict) or organization.get("Moid") != organizationMoid or organization.get("ObjectType") not in (None, "organization.Organization"):
                problems.append("Template Organization does not match the resolved organization.")
            templateTargetPlatform = item.get("TargetPlatform") or ""
            if profileType == "Server":
                if templateTargetPlatform not in ("Standalone", "FIAttached", "UnifiedEdgeServer"):
                    problems.append("Server template TargetPlatform is missing or unsupported.")
                if templateTargetPlatform == "Standalone":
                    serverFamily = item.get("ServerFamily") or ""
                    if not serverFamily:
                        problems.append("Standalone server template ServerFamily is missing; cloning cannot propagate the required ServerFamily value.")
            elif profileType == "Chassis":
                if templateTargetPlatform != "FIAttached":
                    problems.append("Chassis template TargetPlatform must be FIAttached.")
            elif templateTargetPlatform != routeTargetPlatform:
                problems.append("Switch-cluster template TargetPlatform does not match the selected Domain or Unified Edge route.")
        if problems:
            templateStatus = "invalid"
            templateMessage = " ".join(problems)
        else:
            templateMoid = item["Moid"]
            organizationRef = {"ClassId": "mo.MoRef", "ObjectType": "organization.Organization", "Moid": destinationOrganizationMoid}
            sourceRef = {"ClassId": "mo.MoRef", "ObjectType": expectedTemplateObjectType, "Moid": templateMoid}
            target = {"ClassId": expectedProfileObjectType, "ObjectType": expectedProfileObjectType, "Name": newProfileName, "Description": description, "Organization": organizationRef}
            if profileType in ("Server", "Chassis", "Domain", "Unified Edge"):
                target["TargetPlatform"] = templateTargetPlatform
            if profileType == "Server" and templateTargetPlatform == "Standalone":
                target["ServerFamily"] = serverFamily
            request = {"ClassId": "bulk.MoCloner", "ObjectType": "bulk.MoCloner", "Organization": organizationRef, "Sources": [sourceRef], "Targets": [target], "WorkflowNameSuffix": workflowNameSuffix}
            cloneRequestJson = json.dumps(request, separators=(",", ":"))

import re
import sys
_inspectionSucceeded = True
submissionStatus = ''
submissionMessage = ''
submissionResultJson = ''
bulkResponseJson = ''
acceptedResultJson = ''
asyncResultPresent = False
asyncResultMoid = ''
helperReady = False
def _inspect():
    import json
    import re
    import sys
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    statusCode = int(sys.argv[2])
    profileType = sys.argv[3]
    destinationName = sys.argv[4]
    expectedProfileObjectTypes = {
        "Server": "server.Profile",
        "Chassis": "chassis.Profile",
        "Domain": "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile",
        "Unified Edge": "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile",
    }
    expectedProfileObjectType = expectedProfileObjectTypes.get(profileType)
    if not expectedProfileObjectType:
        raise ValueError("Profile Type is unsupported for MoCloner response inspection")
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("MoCloner response must be an object")
    if payload.get("ObjectType") != "bulk.MoCloner" or payload.get("ClassId") not in (None, "bulk.MoCloner"):
        raise ValueError("MoCloner response discriminators are invalid")
    moClonerMoid = str(payload.get("Moid") or "")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moClonerMoid):
        raise ValueError("MoCloner response is missing a URL-safe Moid")
    if statusCode not in (200, 202, 207):
        raise ValueError("MoCloner success response must use HTTP 200, 202, or a validated 207 Multi-Status")
    responseCount = 0
    responseStatus = None
    responseBodyMoid = ""
    if statusCode == 207:
        responses = payload.get("Responses")
        if not isinstance(responses, list):
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner response is missing a Responses array")
        responseCount = len(responses)
        if responseCount != 1:
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner response must contain exactly one result for the one-source/one-target request")
        response = responses[0]
        if not isinstance(response, dict):
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner result must be an object")
        if response.get("ObjectType") != "bulk.RestResult" or response.get("ClassId") not in (None, "bulk.RestResult"):
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner result discriminators are invalid")
        responseStatus = response.get("Status")
        if isinstance(responseStatus, bool) or not isinstance(responseStatus, int) or responseStatus != 200:
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner result must report numeric Status 200")
        responseBody = response.get("Body")
        if not isinstance(responseBody, dict):
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner result is missing an object Body")
        if responseBody.get("ObjectType") != expectedProfileObjectType or responseBody.get("ClassId") not in (None, expectedProfileObjectType):
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner result Body does not match the selected profile type")
        if responseBody.get("Name") != destinationName:
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner result Body does not match the requested profile name")
        responseBodyMoid = str(responseBody.get("Moid") or "")
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", responseBodyMoid):
            raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner result Body is missing a URL-safe profile Moid")
    asyncResult = payload.get("AsyncResult")
    asyncResultPresent = asyncResult is not None
    asyncResultMoid = ""
    if asyncResultPresent:
        if not isinstance(asyncResult, dict) or not asyncResult.get("Moid") or asyncResult.get("ObjectType") != "bulk.Result" or asyncResult.get("ClassId") not in (None, "mo.MoRef", "bulk.Result"):
            raise ValueError("AsyncResult must be a bulk.Result relationship with Moid")
        asyncResultMoid = str(asyncResult["Moid"])
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", asyncResultMoid):
            raise ValueError("AsyncResult Moid is not URL-safe")
    if statusCode == 207 and asyncResultPresent:
        raise ValueError("HTTP 207 MoCloner response must not mix completed per-result data with AsyncResult tracking")
    if statusCode == 202 and not asyncResultPresent:
        submissionStatus = "untrackable"
        submissionMessage = "HTTP 202 was returned without a usable AsyncResult relationship."
    elif statusCode == 207:
        submissionStatus = "synchronous"
        submissionMessage = "HTTP 207 Multi-Status contained exactly one successful profile result; final exact profile verification is required."
    elif asyncResultPresent:
        submissionStatus = "async"
        submissionMessage = "Profile derivation was accepted and returned a trackable AsyncResult."
    else:
        submissionStatus = "synchronous"
        submissionMessage = "MoCloner returned HTTP 200 without AsyncResult; final exact profile verification is required."
    bulkResponseJson = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"))
    acceptedResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "completed": False, "profileType": profileType, "newProfileName": destinationName, "bulkRequest": payload, "asyncResult": asyncResult, "note": "The asynchronous request was accepted; profile creation and final identity were not verified because waiting was disabled."}, separators=(",", ":"))
    submissionResultJson = json.dumps({"status": submissionStatus, "message": submissionMessage, "httpStatus": statusCode, "moClonerMoid": moClonerMoid, "asyncResultMoid": asyncResultMoid or None, "responseCount": responseCount, "responseStatus": responseStatus, "responseBodyMoid": responseBodyMoid or None}, separators=(",", ":"))
    helperReady = submissionStatus in ("untrackable", "async", "synchronous") and bool(submissionMessage and bulkResponseJson and acceptedResultJson and submissionResultJson)
    return locals()

    globals().update(_inspect())
except Exception:
    _inspectionSucceeded = False

_decisionInput1 = sys.argv[6]
_decisionInput2 = sys.argv[7]
_decisionInput3 = sys.argv[8]
_decisionInput4 = sys.argv[9]
_decisionValues = {'decision0': _decisionInput1, 'decision1': _decisionInput2, 'decision2': _decisionInput3, 'decision3': _decisionInput4}
def _classify():
    if (submissionStatus == 'untrackable'):
        _decisionValues['decision2'] = '502'
        _decisionValues['decision3'] = 'MoCloner request was accepted but cannot be tracked'
        _decisionValues['decision0'] = submissionMessage
        _decisionValues['decision1'] = submissionResultJson
        return 'failed-completed', submissionMessage
    elif ((submissionStatus == 'async') and (_decisionInput0 == 'false')):
        _decisionValues['decision2'] = '202'
        _decisionValues['decision3'] = 'Profile derivation request accepted'
        _decisionValues['decision0'] = ''
        _decisionValues['decision1'] = acceptedResultJson
        return 'succeeded', 'Profile derivation request accepted'
    return "", ""

import re
import sys
_inspectionSucceeded = True
status = ''
pollDisposition = ''
pollMessage = ''
pollResultJson = ''
helperReady = False
def _inspect():
    import json
    import sys
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("bulk.Result response must be an object")
    if payload.get("Moid") != expectedMoid or payload.get("ObjectType") != "bulk.Result" or payload.get("ClassId") not in (None, "bulk.Result"):
        raise ValueError("bulk.Result identity or discriminators do not match AsyncResult")
    status = payload.get("Status") or ""
    message = payload.get("StatusMessage") or ""
    progress = {"NotStarted", "ObjPresenceCheckInProgress", "ObjPresenceCheckComplete", "ExecutionInProgress"}
    failure = {"CompletedWithErrors", "Failed", "TimedOut"}
    if status == "Completed":
        pollDisposition = "completed"
    elif status in progress:
        pollDisposition = "in-progress"
    elif status in failure:
        pollDisposition = "failed"
    else:
        pollDisposition = "unexpected"
    pollMessage = message or ("bulk.Result status is " + (status or "<blank>"))
    pollResultJson = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"))
    helperReady = pollDisposition in ("completed", "in-progress", "failed", "unexpected") and bool(pollMessage and pollResultJson)
    return locals()
try:
    globals().update(_inspect())
except Exception:
    _inspectionSucceeded = False
_decisionInput0 = (sys.argv[3].lower() == "true")
_decisionInput1 = sys.argv[4]
_decisionInput2 = sys.argv[5]
_decisionInput3 = sys.argv[6]
_decisionInput4 = sys.argv[7]
_decisionInput5 = sys.argv[8]
_decisionInput6 = sys.argv[9]

def _classify():
    if (pollDisposition == 'failed'):
        _decisionValues['decision5'] = '409'
        _decisionValues['decision6'] = 'Profile derivation reached a terminal failure state'
        _decisionValues['decision3'] = pollMessage
        _decisionValues['decision4'] = pollResultJson
        return 'failed-completed', pollMessage
    elif (pollDisposition == 'unexpected'):
        _decisionValues['decision5'] = '502'
        _decisionValues['decision6'] = 'Profile derivation returned an unknown or blank bulk.Result status'
        _decisionValues['decision3'] = pollMessage
        _decisionValues['decision4'] = pollResultJson
        return 'failed-completed', pollMessage
    elif (pollDisposition == 'completed'):
        _decisionValues['decision0'] = True
        _decisionValues['decision2'] = status
        _decisionValues['decision1'] = pollResultJson
    return "", ""
decisionCompletion, decisionMessage = _classify()
decisionValue0 = _decisionValues['decision0']
decisionValue1 = _decisionValues['decision1']
decisionValue2 = _decisionValues['decision2']
decisionValue3 = _decisionValues['decision3']
decisionValue4 = _decisionValues['decision4']
decisionValue5 = _decisionValues['decision5']
decisionValue6 = _decisionValues['decision6']

import re
import sys
_inspectionSucceeded = True
finalStatus = ''
finalMessage = ''
finalResultJson = ''
helperReady = False
def _inspect():
    import json
    import sys
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    profileType = sys.argv[2]
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
    expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[5]
    expectedServerFamily = sys.argv[6]
    templateMoid = sys.argv[7]
    templateObjectType = sys.argv[8]
    newProfileName = sys.argv[9]
    bulkResponse = json.loads(sys.argv[10])
    asyncResult = json.loads(sys.argv[11])
    waitRequested = sys.argv[14] == 'true'
    asyncResultStatus = sys.argv[13]
    values = payload.get('Results')
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError('Final profile response is missing a Results array')
    createdProfileJson = ''
    if len(values) == 0:
        finalStatus = 'not-found'
        finalMessage = 'No created profile matched the exact destination identity after the request completion path.'
    elif len(values) > 1:
        finalStatus = 'ambiguous'
        finalMessage = 'Multiple created profiles matched the exact destination identity; a duplicate-creation race may have occurred.'
    else:
        item = values[0]
        problems = []
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not item.get('Moid'):
            problems.append('Created profile object or Moid is missing.')
        else:
            if item.get('Name') != newProfileName:
                problems.append('Created profile Name does not match.')
            if item.get('ObjectType') != expectedObjectType or item.get('ClassId') not in (None, expectedObjectType):
                problems.append('Created profile discriminators do not match.')
            organization = item.get('Organization')
            if not isinstance(organization, dict) or organization.get('Moid') != organizationMoid or organization.get('ObjectType') != 'organization.Organization' or (organization.get('ClassId') not in (None, 'mo.MoRef', 'organization.Organization')):
                problems.append('Created profile Organization relationship does not match.')
            source = item.get('SrcTemplate')
            if not isinstance(source, dict) or source.get('Moid') != templateMoid or source.get('ObjectType') != templateObjectType or (source.get('ClassId') not in (None, 'mo.MoRef', templateObjectType)):
                problems.append('Created profile SrcTemplate does not identify the exact source template.')
            actualPlatform = item.get('TargetPlatform') or ''
            if expectedTargetPlatform and actualPlatform != expectedTargetPlatform:
                problems.append('Created profile TargetPlatform does not match the derived target.')
            if profileType == 'Server' and expectedTargetPlatform == 'Standalone' and expectedServerFamily and (item.get('ServerFamily') != expectedServerFamily):
                problems.append('Created Standalone server profile ServerFamily does not match the propagated template value.')
            if asyncResult and asyncResultStatus != 'Completed':
                problems.append('Stored asynchronous result status is not Completed.')
        if problems:
            finalStatus = 'mismatch'
            finalMessage = ' '.join(problems)
        else:
            finalStatus = 'exact'
            finalMessage = 'Created profile identity, organization, source template, discriminators, and platform fields were verified.'
            createdProfileJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(',', ':'))
    result = {'requestAccepted': True, 'completed': finalStatus == 'exact', 'waitRequested': waitRequested, 'profileType': profileType, 'sourceTemplate': {'Moid': templateMoid, 'ObjectType': templateObjectType}, 'createdProfile': json.loads(createdProfileJson) if createdProfileJson else None, 'bulkRequest': bulkResponse, 'asyncResult': asyncResult if asyncResult else None, 'asyncResultStatus': asyncResultStatus or None, 'message': finalMessage}
    finalResultJson = json.dumps(result, separators=(',', ':'))
    helperReady = finalStatus in ('not-found', 'ambiguous', 'mismatch', 'exact') and bool(finalMessage and finalResultJson) and (finalStatus != 'exact' or bool(createdProfileJson))

    return locals()
try:
    globals().update(_inspect())
except Exception:
    _inspectionSucceeded = False
_decisionInput0 = sys.argv[15]
_decisionInput1 = sys.argv[16]
_decisionInput2 = sys.argv[17]
_decisionInput3 = sys.argv[18]
_decisionValues = {'decision0': _decisionInput0, 'decision1': _decisionInput1, 'decision2': _decisionInput2, 'decision3': _decisionInput3}
def _classify():
    if (finalStatus == 'not-found'):
        _decisionValues['decision2'] = '502'
        _decisionValues['decision3'] = 'Created profile could not be verified'
        _decisionValues['decision0'] = finalMessage
        _decisionValues['decision1'] = finalResultJson
        return 'failed-completed', finalMessage
    elif (finalStatus == 'ambiguous'):
        _decisionValues['decision2'] = '409'
        _decisionValues['decision3'] = 'Multiple profiles matched the final identity'
        _decisionValues['decision0'] = finalMessage
        _decisionValues['decision1'] = finalResultJson
        return 'failed-completed', finalMessage
    elif (finalStatus == 'mismatch'):
        _decisionValues['decision2'] = '409'
        _decisionValues['decision3'] = 'Created profile did not match the requested derivation identity'
        _decisionValues['decision0'] = finalMessage
        _decisionValues['decision1'] = finalResultJson
        return 'failed-completed', finalMessage
    _decisionValues['decision2'] = '200'
    _decisionValues['decision3'] = 'Profile derived and verified'
    _decisionValues['decision0'] = ''
    _decisionValues['decision1'] = finalResultJson
    return 'succeeded', 'Profile derived and verified'
    return "", ""
decisionCompletion, decisionMessage = _classify()
decisionValue0 = _decisionValues['decision0']
decisionValue1 = _decisionValues['decision1']
decisionValue2 = _decisionValues['decision2']
decisionValue3 = _decisionValues['decision3']
